CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.daily_sales
(
    sales_date DATE,
    total_orders BIGINT,
    total_items BIGINT,
    gross_sales DECIMAL(23,2),
    total_discount DECIMAL(23,2),
    total_tax DECIMAL(23,2),
    net_sales DECIMAL(23,2),
    average_order_value DECIMAL(13,2)
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'synapse_serving/daily_sales/',
    DATA_SOURCE = EcommerceGold,
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFormat
);


SELECT TOP 10 *
FROM dbo.daily_sales;
